item.title: Rallying Cry – November 6, 2026
item.description: A kind stranger spent 12 days tracking down a laborer to return his lost cash, scientists celebrated the discovery of a rare baby right whale off Canada, geothermal energy is slashing housing costs by 40% across the US, and the economy added a solid 165,000 jobs last month.
